project_info.theme: Winner list recap for Shopee electric scooter campaign
project_info.color_palette: Dark stage red, orange, gold, white

main_subject.detail: A winner-announcement board with the giant title 'DANH SACH TRUNG THUONG'. Five user-submitted portraits are shown inside glowing orange-red frames, each holding up a phone screenshot. Visible names are 'THANH TAI', 'HAU LUONG', 'NGUYEN UYEN', 'LIG MY', and 'NHI MAI'. Bottom CTA line says 'VAN CON NHIEU XE MAY DIEN DANG CHO CHU, VAO SHOPEE LAY NGAY!'.
main_subject.style: Prize-recap collage with framed user photos, stage backdrop, and celebratory reward-show design

Surrounding elements: Shopee logo top left, orange discount tickets, gold statuette silhouettes, Shopee bag icons, name plaques 'THANH TAI', 'HAU LUONG', 'NGUYEN UYEN', 'LIG MY', 'NHI MAI', and bottom line 'VAN CON NHIEU XE MAY DIEN DANG CHO CHU, VAO SHOPEE LAY NGAY!'. Technical style: photo-collage campaign recap poster, stage lighting, warm glow, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
